dedupe_keys.name: barad global bias adjusted radiation grids 1980 2019

description: BaRAD provides monthly global shortwave-radiation grids from 1980 to 2019, separating total, diffuse and direct-beam components. PANGAEA names the deposit, and the Scientific Data article describes a random-forest bias adjustment of MERRA-2 using ground observations at native 0.5 by 0.625-degree resolution. Solar-generation, building-heat or land-surface simulations can use the components as historical forcing or model-check data. These are adjusted estimates, not measured irradiance at every grid cell; station coverage and model structure affect uncertainty. Monthly values also cannot describe sub-hourly photovoltaic fluctuations. DataCite and the own PANGAEA page state CC BY 4.0. I read repository metadata and article methods without downloading NetCDF files or reproducing the bias correction. Related scripts are reviewed separately as a public code repository. No exact catalogue record was found.
